fact: Gazette Notice No. 958 of 14 July 2023: the Bank issued the National Payment Systems Directives on Electronic Money Issuance, 2023, replacing the 2018 directives, with the Bank as regulatory authority over e-money institutions.
title: The National Payment Systems Directives on Electronic Money Issuance, 2023 (Gazette Notice No. 958 of 2023)
publisher: Government Gazette, Republic of Zambia / Bank of Zambia
